entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hi, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hello, Alex. I need to start a return for some cycling shoes I purchased a couple of months ago.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, could I get your name and order number?
Of course. The name is Sam Jones, and the order number is VF789012.
Thank you, Sam. I have your order right here. Before we proceed, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the cycling shoes? Is it a technical fault or a preference issue?

It's a fit issue. I've tried everything, adjusted the cleats a dozen times, but I can't get them to feel right. After any ride over an hour, I end up with painful blisters on my heels. I'd like to get a full refund if possible.
I'm sorry to hear that they're causing blisters; that's definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Let me just check the return eligibility for you. One moment.
Okay, Sam, I see the shoes were delivered 79 days ago. According to our policy, you are well within the 90-day return window. I can go ahead and approve this return for you immediately.

That's great news, thank you. Since I had to go through the trouble and discomfort, and now I have to ship them back, would you be able to add a small discount code to my account for a future purchase? Maybe 10% off a different pair?

I understand the request, and I'm glad we can process the refund for you. However, my system doesn't allow me to issue discount codes for returns like this. The best I can do is ensure your refund is processed as soon as the item is received at our warehouse.
Alright, I thought it was worth asking. The refund is the most important part. Can you email me the return shipping label?

Absolutely. I've just sent the prepaid return label to the email address on file. Just print it out, attach it to the box, and you can drop it off at any post office. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you for your help, Alex.
You're very welcome, Sam. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
